title: tls_openssl Module
content_markdown: This module implements TLS operations using the openSSL libarary. It provides the primitives required by the tls_mgm module in order to expose a higher-level API used by TLS-based protocol modules like proto_tls or proto_wss etc.
overview: This module implements TLS operations using the openSSL libarary. It provides the primitives required by the tls_mgm module in order to expose a higher-level API used by TLS-based protocol modules like proto_tls or proto_wss etc.

dependencies_required.name: openssl
dependencies_required.reason: Required for TLS v1.0 support (>= 0.9.6) and TLS v1.1/1.2 support (>= 1.0.1e). Also known as libssl.

dependencies_required.name: openssl-dev
dependencies_required.reason: Required for TLS v1.0 support and TLS v1.1/1.2 support. Also known as libssl-dev.
